title: First Non-Repeating Character
statementHtml:
Problem statement

Source note: Reported in an Amazon new-grad onsite interview as finding the first non-repeating character. The source omits whether to return a character or index and gives no absent-result, character-domain, case, or size rule; this practice version returns the character, uses the empty string when absent, compares case-sensitive printable ASCII, and limits input length to 100,000. Problem match confidence: approximately 88%.

Given a non-empty string s, return the first character whose total frequency in the string is exactly one.

If no such character exists, return the empty string. Character comparisons are case-sensitive.
